channels.name: OpenAlex
channels.what: works, citations, scholarly topics and affiliated institutions
channels.boundary: Academic abstracts and topic tags do not establish effect size or real-world suitability

channels.name: Europe PMC
channels.what: biomedical works and available open full text
channels.boundary: Abstracts are weaker than full-text appraisal; duplicate versions must be reconciled

channels.name: OpenAIRE Graph
channels.what: funded projects, papers, datasets, software and project links
channels.boundary: Cross-type links and DOI overlap require validation

channels.name: 3ie Evidence Gap Maps
channels.what: interventions versus measured outcomes and evidence holes
channels.boundary: Evidence gap map is not an intervention recommendation

channels.name: Wikidata
channels.what: named entities and structured concept relationships
channels.boundary: Ontology matches do not prove functional equivalence

channels.name: World Bank Projects & Operations
channels.what: country-sector programs, documents, financing and reported implementation
channels.boundary: Project financing and approvals do not prove measured outcomes or procurement availability

channels.name: World Bank Open Data
channels.what: macro/sector indicator series and geography
channels.boundary: Area statistics do not identify an addressable buyer

channels.name: OECD OPSI
channels.what: public sector intervention cases and implementations
channels.boundary: Case narratives generally reflect publisher/source claims

channels.name: HDX Humanitarian Data Exchange
channels.what: humanitarian geospatial and survey datasets
channels.boundary: Metadata alone does not confirm data quality or right to reuse sensitive data

channels.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
channels.what: health indicators across countries
channels.boundary: Aggregated indicators cannot establish project-specific causal effects

channels.name: Our World in Data
channels.what: statistical series and cross-country context
channels.boundary: Charts and correlations cannot be treated as buying signals

channels.name: Data Commons
channels.what: structured geospatial/social/environmental statistics
channels.boundary: Entity/indicator coverage uneven and historic

channels.name: GitHub Search
channels.what: public repository topic scans with time/date metadata
channels.boundary: Repository existence and activity do not establish adoption or correctness

channels.name: ecosyste.ms
channels.what: cross-forge repository/package ecosystem metadata
channels.boundary: Service data may have CC BY-SA and commercial use conditions

channels.name: Digital Public Goods Registry
channels.what: reviewed eligibility registry for public goods
channels.boundary: Eligibility is not field performance

channels.name: Open Sustainable Technology
channels.what: sustainability open-source solution inventory
channels.boundary: Topic listings are not proof of deployability

channels.name: Hugging Face Spaces
channels.what: AI application demonstration inventory
channels.boundary: Demo visibility is not reproducible production performance

channels.name: Hackaday.io
channels.what: open hardware construction and prototype logs
channels.boundary: Hardware projects require BOM, safety and reproducibility checks

channels.name: EU OSOR
channels.what: public-sector open software case references
channels.boundary: Availability does not demonstrate public adoption

channels.name: GitTrend
channels.what: GitHub repository discovery and trending lists
channels.boundary: Trend popularity is not implementation impact

channels.name: OSHWA Open Hardware Certification
channels.what: open source hardware certification directory
channels.boundary: Certification and public design files are not manufacturing qualification

channels.name: EU TED Notices
channels.what: published public procurement requirements and contract notices
channels.boundary: A notice may not be eligible or open; procurement language and deadlines must be checked

channels.name: SAM.gov Opportunities
channels.what: United States federal solicitations and procurement opportunities
channels.boundary: API requires key; notice does not establish ability to bid

channels.name: UNGM Notices
channels.what: UN procurement notices
channels.boundary: The UNGM notices API is authenticated; published notice is not guaranteed contract

channels.name: World Bank Procurement
channels.what: World Bank project procurement notices and awards
channels.boundary: Financed project != open vendor opportunity

channels.name: Algora
channels.what: public OSS issue bounties and contractor matching
channels.boundary: Bounties can be unclaimed, contested or expired

channels.name: GitHub Issues
channels.what: public technical requests and bug reports
channels.boundary: Issue request does not prove employer budget or maintainer permission

channels.name: Open Collective
channels.what: public fundraising and collective financial statements
channels.boundary: Donation balances do not equate to contractor budgets

channels.name: GitHub Sponsors
channels.what: sponsor and maintainer contribution channels
channels.boundary: Sponsor availability is not a buyer procurement request

channels.name: NLnet
channels.what: digital commons research/engineering grant programmes
channels.boundary: Grants not contracts; proposals must meet call terms

channels.name: Product Hunt
channels.what: product launch/adjacent solution reconnaissance
channels.boundary: Launching is not sustained traction

channels.name: AlternativeTo
channels.what: substitutes and alternatives
channels.boundary: User-curated comparisons, not independent functional testing

channels.name: 3ie Development Evidence Portal
channels.what: impact evaluations and systematic reviews
channels.boundary: Evaluations do not imply buyer purchasing interest

channels.name: Taiwan Government Procurement
channels.what: Taiwan public procurement listings and notices
channels.boundary: Portal availability is not confirmed API permission and tender requirements vary
